name: Asymptotic Time and Space Complexity Bounds
description: Theoretical complexity bounds comparing standard algorithms against proposed sparse architectures.
author: The Next Geek Think (NGT)

signature_integration.in_prose_blueprint: The hierarchical index curbs query overhead to $\mathcal{{O}}({complexity})$ time ({tbl_ref}), unlocking sub-linear scaling.

caption_blueprint: {prefix} {num}: {title}. $N$ denotes sequence token length; $d$ denotes hidden representation dimension.
spec:
\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\small
\begin{tabular}{lccc}
\toprule
\textbf{Method} & \textbf{Time Complexity} & \textbf{Space Complexity} & \textbf{Memory Scaling} \\
\midrule
Standard Attention & $\mathcal{O}(N^2 d)$ & $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ & Quadratic \\
Linear Attention & $\mathcal{O}(N d^2)$ & $\mathcal{O}(N d)$ & Linear \\
Proposed Hierarchical & $\mathcal{O}(N \log N d)$ & $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$ & Quasi-linear \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
